definitions.cer_raw: Character error, letters and digits only (Greek pages: Greek letters only), nothing folded: case, ſ, accents and u/v all count. Fitting alignment (lib/metrics.mjs windowedErrorRate), so text outside the reference window is free. A refused page counts as 1.
definitions.cer_prompt: The same, after the fold the live OCR prompt asks for: abbreviations the reference keeps, expanded as the engine expanded them; Unicode NFKC with æ/œ and other ligatures written out; ſ as s (the stored house convention); CJK old/new forms. Not folded: u/v, i/j, capitals, spelling, accents and marks.
definitions.kinds: ocr-error-classes.py with prompt_rules=True, grouped (READER_KIND). Share of the classified error weight, weighted by the characters of the affected words: a ranking, not a CER. A heuristic: see the hand-check.
definitions.prompt: benchmark generic = benchmark-run-api.mjs GENERIC_PROMPT; v16 / v16 + long-s line = long-s-tcp-ab.mjs arms; served = pages.ocr resolved to its prompts row by prompt_id, then prompt_hash, else the stored label (unresolved).

live_prompt.long_s: no rule in any version v0–v19.1; v16 writes s by habit; the collector folds ſ to s only after the long-s retry
